basis: Actual downloaded provider collider; collection GLB pre-decode validator, Three GLTFLoader and BVH raycasts. Surface identity awaits the rendered world.
coordinates: Three Y-up scene units: root rotation.x=Math.PI, unit scale, no added translation. Provider metric metadata is retained separately and not applied twice.
patchLimits: Downward samples and short upward rays test the coarse collider, not the splat imagery. A clear patch still requires render QA; no physical accuracy claim.
